quote: Great works are performed not by strength, but perseverance; yonder palace was raised by single stones, yet you see its height and spaciousness. He that shall walk with vigour three hours a day, will pass in seven years a space equal to the circumference of the globe.
source: Samuel Johnson, The History of Rasselas, Prince of Abissinia, ch. 13 (Imlac, to Prince Rasselas)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg #652 plain text of Rasselas, read in place: lines 1302 to 1306 under CHAPTER XIII, RASSELAS DISCOVERS THE MEANS OF ESCAPE
evidence.edition: Samuel Johnson, Rasselas, Prince of Abyssinia (Cassell’s National Library text); Project Gutenberg #652; first published 1759
evidence.locator: Chapter XIII, the close of the speech given to “his companion” as the two rest from digging; the paragraph opens “Imlac procured instruments proper to hew stone”, so the companion is Imlac

speaker: Imlac, to Prince Rasselas
reason: Both sentences are verbatim and consecutive in chapter XIII, closing Imlac’s speech to the discouraged Prince. Not shipped, Johnson unused this year, not banned.
